# Rockstar_ibot — 資金調達応募の正本回答

## 何を作っていますか

Rockstar_ibotは、身体・心・お金と現実のfollow-throughを管理し、委任範囲で行動して、設置者が接続したTelegram botへ証拠付きの結果を返せるproactive general agentです。

## 何をしますか

Daily Organは予定と応募を進め、Physical / Mental Organは生活習慣とwellbeingを支え、Financial Organは総資産、収支、支出、収入機会、crypto、riskを制御した資産運用を管理します。提案だけで終わらず、許可された行動を実行し、receiptを保存します。

## Missionと長期vision

End suffering for humans and, ultimately, all living beings by making dependable care, agency, and verified access to essentials continuously available. Rockstar_ibot grows from managing one human life across physical health, mental wellbeing, finances, work, and schedules into a general manager and essentials-distribution network for every living being.

## 現在地

The local runtime, owner-only Hub, Kai-owned private GitHub repository, public avocadomini site, Kai-owned @avocadominibot Webhook and command profile, Supabase durable job queue, Railway Core, Mac Codex bridge, multiple specialist loops, essentials-only request policy and planner, and a purpose-gated vendor bank-request builder exist. Real-user Telegram-to-Codex message receipts, bot-token rotation, automatic GitHub deployment credentials, Kai-owned live bank credentials, procurement vendors, delivery providers, billing, and receipt-backed revenue are not yet verified. No receipt-backed Rockstar_ibot revenue claim has been verified for Kai.

## Business model

Free, open-source, self-hosted Rockstar_ibot. A future paid monthly option for an always-on hosted Rockstar_ibot; pricing and billing are not configured.
